source.title: Mapping NIS2 Obligations with ECSF Role Profiles
source.applicability: NIS2 entities implementing role-specific cybersecurity responsibilities through the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) alignment

passages.text: Each role is mapped to its specific tasks, assisting entities in understanding what personnel capabilities are required to fulfil these obligations successfully.
To implement the directive effectively, entities should define internal cybersecurity roles and responsibilities aligned with its requirements7.

ABOUT ENISA

The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity, ENISA, is the Union’s agency dedicated to
achieving a high common level of cybersecurity across Europe. Established in 2004 and
strengthened by the EU Cybersecurity Act, the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity
contributes to EU cyber policy, enhances the trustworthiness of ICT products, services and
processes with cybersecurity certification schemes,
